name: Steinfurt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Steinfurt (a castle on blue beneath a lozengy chief).
history: Municipal flag of Steinfurt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Steinfurt arms — castle beneath lozengy chief
